# Bren Case

Bren Case is a postdoctoral associate in Epidemiology & Biostatistics at the University of Georgia and a member of The Fox Lab. Research in the lab includes infectious disease forecasting and genomic surveillance.

## Research And Lab Highlights

### International forecasting

Bren presented real-time forecasts of respiratory hospitalizations in Paraguay at OPTIONS XII, receiving the best presentation award in the Public Health and Policy track.

[Read the lab update](../../news/index.qmd#brens-award-winning-options-xii-presentation)

### Genomic surveillance

Bren presented research on optimal sample sizes for genomic surveillance, in collaboration with the Massachusetts Department of Public Health, at the CDC InsightNet annual meeting.

[Read the lab update](../../news/index.qmd#cdc-insightnet-annual-meeting)
